svg.text: The 3D Compute Lattice (Token t × Depth l × Pass r) and Where Diffusion Forcing Duality Breaks
Every recent architecture occupies one edge family in a single 3D tensor; Diffusion Forcing spans two orthogonal slices, snapping at the missing exogenous kernel q.
Left: Unified 3D Compute Cube (node = token t, layer l, pass r)
Vertical depth read (along l): AttnRes / SimpleHC / Loom matrix M
Same-depth horizontal (t−1, l)→(t, l): LLLM affine scan / MSAR / MShift (1× FLOPs)
Cross-depth shift=1 (t−1, l'≥l)→(t, l): FBT / TR / LoRM / ALF (1-pass dec, Jacobi train)
In-place loop shift=0 (t, l', r−1)→(t, l, r): Huginn / Ouro / Inkling / LoopRes (K-pass)
Right: Two Diffusion Forcing Slices & Where the Duality Snaps
diagonal wavefront refines t & drafts jointly
